bio: This welcoming restaurant in the heart of Arrowtown sports a cosy dining room, a relaxing patio and a Vespa oozing vintage Italian charm. The menu offers handmade pasta and pizzas that stay true to their roots. The ravioli, filled with ricotta and spinach or Angus beef, and served in basilico or butter and sage sauce, is always blissful. Round off with limoncello and cantucci biscotti in true Italian style.
